title: Leak Reveals Nothing's First AI Device.. No Screen and Its Button Says 'Talk'! 🔍
body: Leak Reveals Nothing's First AI Device.. No Screen and Its Button Says 'Talk'! 🔍

A leaked image today shows Nothing's first AI device: a small palm-sized device, a slim dark rectangular body, with no screen, a rectangular physical button that says "Talk", a small circular control below it, and two indicator lights shaped like dots, one red and one green. The company's CEO previously confirmed that its first AI product will launch in December and will have no screen.

A screen-free device means you talk to it instead of touching it — like a small voice assistant you carry in your pocket. But be careful: this is a leak story, not an official announcement, and its function is not yet confirmed — it could be a real-time translator, an AI voice recorder, or a smart note-taking device, and these are only guesses; the company has not confirmed any function, name, or price.
A screen-free device you only talk to.. would you buy it? 🎙️
